title: 我无法通过快捷键使用文本提取器
author: GISer-Qiu

judgment.rationale: The report is too sparse to prove the failing activation layer, but repository inspection identifies a plausible shortcut-to-overlay path and a concrete low-confidence fix direction.
evidence: The report names TextExtractor, PowerToys 0.101.2362, Windows NT 10.0.26200.0, a per-user non-elevated installation, and zh-Hans-HK locale.
The reproduction and expected behavior fields contain only 无; there is no observed behavior, configured shortcut, comment, attachment, or diagnostic.
PowerOCRModuleInterface parses the activation hotkey and starts PowerToys.PowerOCR.exe; KeyboardMonitor compares pressed keys and launches overlays.
No assignee, duplicate, linked PR, or maintainer diagnosis is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Request activation details and a fresh diagnostic while investigating the shortcut parsing/registration and overlay process handoff.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt is linked and a repository code change may apply, but the missing shortcut and symptom details make the root cause unconfirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Make Text Extractor shortcut registration and overlay launch robust to configured-key state
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the configured activation shortcut is not being recognized or the PowerOCR process is not launched/signaled for this user, possibly due to settings parsing, global-hook key naming, or a startup failure. The issue does not identify which branch fails.
plan: Capture the configured shortcut and exact visible response, then inspect logs for hotkey registration, PowerToys.PowerOCR.exe launch, and overlay activation.
Compare the stored activation shortcut produced by PowerOCRModuleInterface::parse_hotkey with KeyboardMonitor.SetActivationKeys and the key names returned by Helper.GetKeyName.
Fix only the confirmed mismatch or process/event failure; preserve custom shortcuts, modifier ordering, per-user install behavior, and the single PowerOCR instance contract.
Add focused tests for shortcut parsing/key normalization and an activation smoke test for the overlay process.
verification: Configure the reported shortcut, trigger it while Text Extractor is enabled, and verify the selection overlay appears.
Test the default and one custom shortcut, including modifier order and release/retrigger.
Verify a launch failure is logged and surfaced rather than silently returning.

confidence.rationale: The relevant symbols are identified, but the issue supplies no actual symptom beyond the title and no configured shortcut.

issue_context.summary: A Text Extractor shortcut problem is reported in Chinese, but the issue provides no configured shortcut, observed response, activation comparison, or diagnostic.
known_information: The affected feature is TextExtractor on PowerToys 0.101.2362.
The environment is Windows NT 10.0.26200.0, .NET 10.0.11, per-user, non-elevated, stable channel, zh-Hans-HK.
The issue has no comments, attachments, assignee, or linked remediation.
inferences: Possible failure layers include shortcut configuration/parsing, global keyboard-hook recognition, PowerToys.PowerOCR.exe startup, or overlay invocation.
Locale may be incidental; no evidence currently ties it to OCR startup.
issue_context.analysis: The source gives a specific, testable activation chain, so a low-confidence design is more useful than a generic log request. Exact user evidence is still required before selecting a code branch.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete live issue body and the absence of discussion or linked work.
Inspected PowerOCRModuleInterface::parse_hotkey, enable, on_hotkey, and launch_process.
Reviewed existing PowerOCR UI test coverage for hotkey activation.

information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes key parsing/registration from process or overlay startup.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Provide a screenshot of the shortcut setting and describe any notification, cursor change, overlay, or complete lack of response.

design.root_cause: Unconfirmed. The leading hypothesis is a mismatch or failure in the configured shortcut-to-PowerOCR overlay activation chain; no evidence identifies whether the failure occurs before on_hotkey, in launch_process, or after the invoke event.
evidence: [Observed] The issue contains no reproduction or actual behavior beyond the title.
[Observed] PowerOCRModuleInterface parses a stored activation shortcut, exposes it to the runner, launches PowerToys.PowerOCR.exe, and signals an invoke event.
[Observed] KeyboardMonitor independently normalizes configured key names and launches overlays from a global keyboard hook.
[Inferred] Comparing these two activation paths is the narrowest useful investigation boundary.

affected_files.purpose: Parses the configured shortcut, exposes it to the runner, starts PowerOCR, and handles hotkey events.
Recognizes configured global key combinations and launches OCR overlays.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The native module parses shortcut JSON and exposes a Hotkey to the runner; the managed process independently splits and sorts setting key names, then launches the overlay on a matching global-hook sequence.
implementation_steps.change: Use the captured shortcut and logs to correct the confirmed normalization, registration, process, or event mismatch. Keep one canonical representation or an explicit conversion boundary and log failed process startup.
implementation_steps.code_block: stored shortcut -> native Hotkey -> runner on_hotkey -> PowerOCR process/event\nstored shortcut -> KeyboardMonitor normalized keys -> global hook -> overlay\nconfirmed mismatch: normalize once at boundary; confirmed launch failure: return/log explicit failure
edge_cases: Custom modifier combinations and key-name casing must remain supported.
Do not trigger repeatedly while keys are held.
Preserve per-user process lifetime and the single-instance mutex.
Do not swallow unrelated keyboard input when activation does not match.
tests: Unit-test parsing/normalization for default and custom shortcuts.
Extend existing PowerOCR UI activation coverage for a retrigger and process-start failure where feasible.
Manually test zh-Hans-HK and an English locale only if locale-specific evidence emerges.

verify: Capture the configured shortcut and reproduce with Text Extractor enabled.
Run the existing PowerOCR targeted test project or the narrowest discovered module test command.
Confirm default/custom shortcut activation opens the selection overlay and that failures produce diagnostic logs.
risks: Changing global-hook matching can affect all Text Extractor shortcut configurations.
Changing process/event lifetime can leave a stale PowerOCR instance or break disable/re-enable behavior.
alternatives: Change the default shortcut; rejected because the configured shortcut is unknown and the default may not be the failing case.
Request only a bug report; rejected as the sole outcome because the activation chain and existing tests provide a concrete low-confidence direction.
Assume locale is causal; rejected because no locale-specific evidence is present.

design.title: Make Text Extractor shortcut activation observable and robust

actions.label: Request Text Extractor activation evidence

comment.body: Thanks for reporting the Text Extractor shortcut problem. Please share a screenshot of the configured Text Extractor shortcut and describe exactly what happens when you press it, including whether there is no response, a notification, cursor change, or selection overlay. Also confirm whether Text Extractor can be started from Settings or another activation surface. Immediately after reproducing the failure, add a comment containing `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP so the logs can distinguish shortcut recognition from PowerOCR startup.
